description: This file is a Perl script that implements a utility for flashing the firmware on Linksys ADSL2MUE devices. It includes network communication, device discovery via broadcast UDP, FTP interactions for firmware transfer, and partition handling logic.

classes.name: ADAM2FTP
classes.description: A subclass of Net::FTP tailored for communicating with ADAM2 devices, providing methods for environment variable retrieval and reboot commands.

methods.name: _USER
methods.description: Sends a USER command to the FTP server.

methods.name: _GETENV
methods.description: Retrieves an environment variable value from the FTP server.

methods.name: getenv
methods.description: Public method to get an environment variable value.

methods.name: _REBOOT
methods.description: Issues a reboot command over FTP.

methods.name: reboot
methods.description: Calls _REBOOT and closes the FTP connection.
